themes.label: Battlefield AI challenging humanitarian law
themes.definition: Use of AI on the battlefield is presented as challenging international humanitarian law, within a broader narrative of militarization and weaponization of new domains.
themes.inclusion: Include passages stating that military or battlefield AI strains or violates international humanitarian law or is part of weaponization trends.
themes.exclusion: Exclude weaponization of space or cyberspace passages that do not mention AI.
themes.boundary_cases: A single-sentence mention of battlefield AI is still coded here because the military use is explicit, not as a generic list mention.

examples.quote: the use of artificial intelligence is challenging international humanitarian law on the battlefield

value.rationale: The single Sri Lanka 2024 passage mentions AI once, specifically as a battlefield technology challenging international humanitarian law, amid concerns about rising weapons spending, nuclear discourse and weaponized domains.
